Companion Animal Travel Desk guide for reptile travel

Use this guide fast if you are moving a reptile through Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk handles live-animal checks, crate review, and cabin guidance in a calm way. Keep the animal settled, keep documents close, and tell the desk about any special handling needs before you reach the counter.

At the desk, staff will look over the crate, confirm the booking, and check that the animal can travel under the current rules. <<FACT F078>> Bring the pet in a secure carrier and keep the area quiet so the animal stays low-stress. If the traveler has more than one pet, each animal gets reviewed on its own.

Weight matters too, since the pet and crate must meet the limit before acceptance. <<FACT F066>> If the setup looks bulky, the staff may ask for a different crate or a new travel plan. This is normal and helps protect the animal, the cabin team, and the flight itself.

During the trip, the cabin team monitors animals and follows the handling notes already on file. They stay alert for heat, cold, or rough movement, and they pass concerns to the right crew right away. Travelers should keep feeding, watering, and cleaning plans simple so the reptile stays stable.

If you are unsure about a crate, document, or route, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head out.
